# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `ringcentral-chat` MCP server pointing at RingCentral's hosted team chat endpoint (`https://mcp.labs.ringcentral.com/ringex/v1.1.0/team-chat`).
- Display name is RingCentral Chat, matching RingCentral Phone.
- Replaces the `ringcentral-team-chat` plugin. Both point at the same team chat endpoint.
- Logo: RingCentral's mark from the `ringcentral` GitHub organization avatar, 256×256.
